voice.name: Loic
voice.why: A plain conversational middle-aged French voice for the garage and car lot mechanics. The game has male bodies only; the voice is male.

greet.text: Mind the oil. What is wrong with it?

what.text: I fix cars. A new battery, a repair kit, the right fuel, and it runs. Most breakdowns are a flat battery.

where.text: The car lot is on the east side, and the fuel station is down the road. Fill up before you go far.

rumour.text: Somebody keeps asking me how to start a car without the key. I tell them to buy the key.
